page_title: LEV 3-1 EIN | Bayer Leverkusen v Eintracht Frankfurt 12/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Deniz Aytekin has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' 3 - 1 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take a perfectly positioned free kick. He sends a sweet strike towards the top right corner, bouncing in off the post. Pure magic.
90+7' This is a yellow card! Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+6' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick.
90+4' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a yellow card.
90+4' Eintracht Frankfurt couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+2' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) will not continue in today's match after receiving a second yellow card then the mandatory red.
90+1' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Mark Flekken.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' The ball is cleared after Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
88' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
88' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes it short.
86' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

85' Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Michael Zetterer makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
83' Substitution. Can Yilmaz Uzun walks off the pitch and Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Jonathan Burkardt.
83' It will be a substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Jean-Matteo Bahoya walks off.
82' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Nathan Tella.
82' That's the end of the game for Patrik Schick, who is replaced by Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Shots on target – 6:1.
79' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets booked for the first time in this match.
79' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged for offside.
78' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Deniz Aytekin's book.

77' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a pin-point pass in the middle of the pitch which gives him a great opportunity to score. He is unfazed by the distance and slams the ball towards the goal. He is unlucky as he hits one of his own teammates.
76' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
73' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) is able to continue to play. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
72' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Oscar Hojlund and he is replaced by Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opposition player and Deniz Aytekin signals a foul.
70' The attendance is 30210.
69' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Fares Chaibi.
67' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) prepares to take a corner kick.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
66' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.

64' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
63' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
62' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Malik Tillman.
61' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the crossbar! If it had flown a little bit lower it would have been a cracker!
59' This was really stupid from Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Deniz Aytekin.
58' The game is interrupted as Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged offside.
57' Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
54' It looks like Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) saw red with that tackle. Deniz Aytekin won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

53' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
52' 2 - 1 Goal! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 2:1.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

51' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
49' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
48' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' 2 - 0 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Michael Zetterer into the bottom left corner.
45+4' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!

45+3' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Deniz Aytekin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a penalty!
45+2' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

45+2' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.

44' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Nathan Tella. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
43' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
41' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
40' 9:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
37' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a cross from Jean-Matteo Bahoya, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.

36' What a chance that is! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
35' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

35' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
34' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Nathan Tella, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.

32' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
31' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
29' The percentage of ball possession is – 36:64.
26' Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
23' Nathan Tella links up with Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who fires just over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
20' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
19' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
19' The main referee, Deniz Aytekin, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card for dissent.

17' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.

17' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
16' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Kasper Hjulmand is forced to make a change. Exequiel Palacios is unable to continue due to injury, Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
13' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' 1 - 0 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and sends the ball into the top right corner. What a stunning goal!
10' Rasmus Kristensen is being substituted because of an injury. Dino Toppmoller sends Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) on the pitch.
8' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

7' One of the Eintracht Frankfurt players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
6' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to find Rasmus Kristensen, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
6' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
4' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an injury.
3' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a long through ball, but Mark Flekken deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
1' The first half has just begun.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Deniz Aytekin will referee today's match.
